component.name: Lantern
component.summary: Author Markdown slide decks with live preview

description.p: Lantern is a small GUI for making Marp slide decks on GNOME. Edit on the left. See the slide render on the right. Present from the same window.
It runs on Marp, so your Marp Markdown works as is. Themes, directives, backgrounds, fragments. Lantern handles the editor, the live preview, present mode, and export.
A deck saves as one .lantern file. The slides, images, and fonts stay together. Rename it to .zip if you want to look inside.

ul.li: Editor and live preview side by side, or focus on one
Present full screen, or in a plain window for screen sharing
Export to PDF, PowerPoint, or HTML
One portable .lantern file holds the whole deck
Drop in images and fonts. Lantern writes the reference for you
Pick a theme or edit its CSS. Set fonts for the body, headings, and code
Saves as you type. Follows the system light and dark setting

screenshot.caption: Edit Markdown on the left, watch the slide render on the right
Start a new presentation or open an existing deck
Pick a theme, edit its CSS, and add images and fonts in Resources
Set a default author name and tune the preview in Preferences

description.p: A reliability release, from a top-to-bottom audit of saving, exporting, and presenting.

ul.li: Quit now asks about unsaved changes instead of discarding them.
PDF export reports failures properly and no longer leaks memory when a print goes wrong.
Picking a theme or assigning a font no longer silently saves the deck, wipes undo history, or moves the cursor.
Adding images, fonts, or metadata marks the deck unsaved, so closing prompts to keep them.
Images with spaces in their file names now render.
Importing a Markdown file brings its local images along.
Opening a deck no longer freezes the window while the preview starts.
Leaving fullscreen via the window manager exits presenting cleanly.
Saving over an existing file always asks first.
Stale working folders from crashes are cleaned up at launch.

description.p: A maintenance release. Screenshots are served from the ursa.nz software repository.

ul.li: Download Lantern as a .deb package for Debian and Ubuntu.
Or grab the AppImage and run it anywhere, no install needed.

description.p: A round of fixes for longer sessions. Your work is safer on the way out, your theme edits stay put, and the preview keeps up.

ul.li: Close a deck with unsaved changes and Lantern asks first. Save, discard, or keep editing.
Edit a theme, switch to another, and switch back. Your changes are still there.
Drop several images at once and place them one at a time.
The live preview stays up through a long editing session.

description.p: Lantern 1.0. This release is about style. Choose a theme, edit its CSS, and place images with real control. The rest is polish that added up along the way.

ul.li: Choose a Marp built-in theme, one Lantern ships (Ink or Dusk), or your own.
Edit the theme CSS in your editor. Save, and the preview follows.
Place an image with options that matter. Inline or background, size, split, and filters.
Set the body, heading, or monospace font from the deck's own fonts.
Title a deck, name its author, and reopen recent decks from the welcome screen.
See your newest images first, and sort the list when you need to.

description.p: A big release. Decks now save as one file. Drop images and fonts straight in. Export and present from the same window.

ul.li: Save a whole deck as one .lantern file. Slides, images, and fonts together.
New Resources window. Drop in images and fonts. Insert them with a click.
Export to PDF and PowerPoint. No bundled browser.
Runs on Intel, AMD, and ARM machines.

description.p: First cut: editor, preview, autosave, light/dark, layout toggle.
